title: Trallie: from Free-Form Text to Structured Data with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.30773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trallie is an open-source framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform information extraction (IE) from natural language sources with or without user guidance. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets or domain-specific training, Trallie enables the conversion of unstructured data into structured formats with minimal or no representative examples. The framework is designed with three key objectives: (i) reducing manual annotation by harnessing prompt-based zero-shot and few-shot capabilities of modern LLMs, (ii) flexibly parsing diverse document formats (i.e., HTML, PDF, TXT, and JSON), and (iii) improving accessibility for non-expert users by automatically inducing schemas from document collections, which can then be refined for extraction. We evaluate Trallie with open-weight LLMs on FDA 510(k) documents and on movie and university websites from SWDE. It outperforms previously reported

translated_title: Trallie：利用大语言模型将自由格式文本转换为结构化数据
translated_abstract: Trallie 是一个开源框架，它利用大语言模型（LLM）在有或没有用户指导的情况下从自然语言来源进行信息抽取（IE）。与依赖大量标注数据集或领域专用训练的传统方法不同，Trallie 能够在仅有最少甚至没有代表性示例的情况下，将非结构化数据转换为结构化格式。该框架的设计包含三个关键目标：（i）通过利用现代大语言模型基于提示的零样本和少样本能力来减少人工标注；（ii）灵活解析多种文档格式（即 HTML、PDF、TXT 和 JSON）；（iii）通过从文档集合中自动归纳抽取模式来提升非专家用户的易用性，这些模式随后可以被细化用于信息抽取。我们在 FDA 510(k) 文档以及 SWDE 数据集中的电影和大学网站上，使用开源权重的大语言模型对 Trallie 进行了评估，其表现优于先前报告的方法。
tldr: Trallie 是一个开源框架，利用大语言模型的零样本/少样本能力实现多种文档格式的信息抽取，并可自动从文档集合中归纳抽取模式，让非专家用户也能便捷地将非结构化文本转换为结构化数据。
